name: Mega menu
summary: A navbar item that opens a wide panel of grouped links, with descriptions, a featured card and a footer row.
description:
Use a mega menu when a site has more pages than fit in a row of navbar links, such as products, solutions or resources. Each group gets a title and each link can carry a one-line description.

It is a <details class="v-mega"> inside .v-navbar-links, so it opens and closes without JS, and the same name on each one keeps only one panel open. On a wide navbar the panel drops below the whole bar; in a narrow slot it opens inline in the mobile menu sheet. Add data-v-mega for Escape, click outside and focus leaving.

classes.name: v-mega
classes.description: The <details> element, inside an <li> of .v-navbar-links. Its <summary> is the trigger and looks like a navbar link.

classes.name: v-mega-chevron
classes.description: The chevron icon in the summary. It turns when the panel is open.

classes.name: v-mega-panel
classes.description: The panel: below the navbar at full width when the navbar is wide, inline in the mobile menu when it is narrow.

classes.name: v-mega-grid
classes.description: Columns of groups that fit the width (each at least 12rem).

classes.name: v-mega-title
classes.description: A small uppercase group title. Give it an id and point the list's aria-labelledby at it.

classes.name: v-mega-links
classes.description: The list of links in a group, on a <ul>.

classes.name: v-mega-link
classes.description: One link: an icon, a title and an optional .v-mega-link-text description.

classes.name: v-mega-link-text
classes.description: The one-line description under a link title.

classes.name: v-mega-feature
classes.description: A highlighted card in the grid, for a launch, a case study or a call to action.

classes.name: v-mega-footer
classes.description: A row under the grid for a secondary link, such as "Book a demo" or "All products".

states.description: On .v-mega: the panel is showing. Set it in the server markup to render a panel open.
On .v-mega: give every mega menu in one navbar the same name so opening one closes the others.
On a .v-mega-link: the current page, tinted in the accent colour.

hooks.name: data-v-mega
hooks.description: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the summary (the mobile sheet stays open). A click outside, focus moving out, or a followed link closes it.

keyboard.action: On the summary, opens or closes the panel.
Moves through the links in the panel in reading order. Leaving the panel closes it (with data-v-mega).
Closes the panel and returns focus to the summary (with data-v-mega).

a11y: This is the disclosure navigation pattern, not role="menu": the links stay ordinary links in reading order, which suits site navigation.
The summary reports expanded and collapsed by itself, so no aria-expanded is needed.
Panels open on click or Enter, never on hover alone, so nothing opens by accident and touch works the same as a mouse.
Label each group: an id on .v-mega-title and aria-labelledby on its .v-mega-links.

examples.title: Product and resources menus
examples.description: Two mega menus and a plain link. Open Product, then Resources: only one stays open. Make the window narrow to see them inside the mobile menu.
